notes: Firm-quarter panel 1992Q2-1997Q2 (qofd 129-149, 21 quarters), 3,882 anonymized firms, 40,016 rows, unbalanced. treat = 1 from the firm's mandatory EDGAR phase-in quarter; absorbing (0 switch-offs). 15 adoption cohorts (first treated quarter 135-149), 2,030 never-treated firms within the window (52.3% of firms), 74 always-treated firms (treat = 1 in every observed quarter). Outcome icc in percent, SD 6.130127 in the regression sample; authors' coef / SD = -0.0510775. in_abstract_intro left false because the abstract gives no number. The article excludes each firm's EDGAR phase-in quarter (Table 2 note), which is why no treated firm is observed at g-1. Columns 2-6 (industry linear trends, controls, pweights, alternative ICC measures) and the PSM/stacked tables are ineligible.
